subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
An analog signal is band-limited to  Hz, sampled at 
the Nyquist rate and the samples are quantized into 
4 levels. The quantization levels Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q4 
(messages) are assumed independent. If they occur 
with the probabilities P1 = P2 = 1/8 and P2 = P3 = 3/8, 
then the information rate of the source is  
 
(a)  10 bits/s 
(b)  5 bits/s 
 
(c)  3.6 bits/s 
(d)  2 bits/s
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-08 (Information Theory).
